# Real cleanup save consumer

`prepare-save.c` authors the behavior at Metapad 0x5c2a and 0x5c34: clean the
mutable text and subtract the returned removal count from the current length
word. Every uint32 length is admitted, including wrapping subtraction. The
original two EBX argument pushes and EDI/ESI continuation values are machine
transport obligations, not additional production source APIs.

`exact/` was generated from the retained checked transfer plan
33f6ad7e3e6b1541d59ed2279b14621e2cb9bcf7582b8957bbc6fd727acf2590.
Its complete source map retains dependency provenance; only the two owned caller
transfers and generic support are compiled in the consumer proof. Neither the
original cleanup function nor its portable implementation enters that model.

`summary-input.json` is input data for tests of the caller composition rule.
Tests replace the supplier evidence importer to keep unit checks small; this file
is not a proof receipt. The public experiment independently imports the actual
checked cleanup composition product, including its complete evidence. Supplier
runtime/service premises and concrete caller entry applicability remain
conditional and cannot authorize native activation.
